scope: Synthetic PR baseline; not a real deployed service
unresolved: Production revocation SLA requires owner approval; fixture uses explicit synthetic 30-unit SLA
Expected maximum distinct keys and eviction budget need measurement

findings.exploit: Prime red/alice/report/read grant, then request same subject/resource/action in blue tenant; baseline reuses red cache key. No authority/admin attacker capability required.
findings.reproduction: python run.py baseline; FAIL cross tenant isolation
findings.fix: Include tenant, subject, resource, action as typed key; retain version in entry and fixed TTL
findings.regression: cross tenant isolation; cross subject isolation; cross resource isolation; cross action isolation

findings.exploit: After legitimate cached grant expires and invalidation is lost, authority outage must not extend permission indefinitely.
findings.reproduction: python run.py mutant_stale_on_error; FAIL expired grant fails closed on outage
findings.fix: Fail closed only for that failed read; do not turn unavailability into long-lived authoritative deny
findings.regression: expired grant fails closed on outage; transient outage not permanent denial

performance_review.hot_keys: Verifier proves repeated fresh read does not call authority; no throughput claim
performance_review.policy_churn: Version-aware invalidation triggers next lookup; old events do not evict newer entry
performance_review.outage: Fresh permissions serve only through fixed TTL; expired deny/allow both fail closed
performance_review.residual: Unbounded distinct-key map is a memory risk; add capacity eviction before production. Cache disabling is not proposed as sole fix.
